reply.text: That's a wound and a medical matter, not something I can judge from here. Stitches in the palm are one for your doctor or the clinic that closed it, and they'll tell you what's safe for grip and when. Once they've cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll build your training around it, with the grip-heavy work either kept light or swapped out. Until then, I'd keep heavy pulling and anything that loads your hand off the table.
